findings.proposed: No mandatory rewording: flag for a rendered check at the narrowest header width. If truncation is observed, the term-preserving shortenings are «Trò chuyện mới» (14 cells) and «Trò chuyện mới với {target}» (27 cells including the placeholder, 19 before it); both drop the «cuộc» classifier used by the sidebar New chat label, so keep the current values if the header has room.
findings.reason: The two header titles are materially longer than English (new_chat is 2.4x) and the h2 is `truncate`; the new_chat_with fixed prefix is 24 cells, so with the 8-cell placeholder the template already sits at 32/32 and any target longer than 8 cells exceeds the budget (English leaves about 17 cells for the target), so a typical agent or team name can be cut. The sidecar calls maxCells advisory, not measured fit; this is a rendered-fit flag, not a proven overflow.

observations.issue: «Hiển thị bản ghi» is a verb phrase where the sidecar specifies a noun-phrase overflow submenu trigger; in the menu it can read as the action «display the transcript» rather than the display-mode setting the submenu chooses.
observations.recommendation: If a future copy pass touches it, «Chế độ hiển thị bản ghi» (23 cells, within maxCells 28) states the setting and keeps transcript → bản ghi. Not counted: pre-existing, previously audited clean.

observations.issue: «Nó sẽ ẩn khỏi danh sách cuộc trò chuyện cho đến khi bạn khôi phục.» reads as a future/passive consequence where the English states the present state («It is hidden»); the pronoun «Nó» is optional in Vietnamese.
observations.recommendation: If touched, «Cuộc trò chuyện này đã được lưu trữ nên bị ẩn khỏi danh sách cho đến khi bạn khôi phục.» is more direct. Not counted: the tooltip sits on an already-archived badge and the statement is not false.

observations.issue: Carry-over width overruns: close «Đóng chi tiết lượt chạy» is 23 cells against maxCells 20 (en 17); open «Mở chi tiết lượt chạy» is 21 against 20 (en 15).
observations.recommendation: No shorter phrasing preserves the established «lượt chạy» term («Đóng chi tiết» would drop «run»); flag alongside VI-BIND-H1 if a rendered check runs. Not counted separately: pre-existing keys and auto-width overflow-menu rows.
